text:
olivia: Draft ready — copy + benchmarks in the doc and a PR for the site: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xDRAFT | PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/242. Target publish Wed 4/7 10am PT. Need marketing + product + legal quick pass. Thoughts?
maria: Looking good. Quick ask — can we frame the benchmark line around 'median token latency' instead of raw throughput? customers call out latency more.
jamal: Also we need a clear webinar CTA near the top. Where will the registration link live? Need final UTM scheme so paid/organic tracking aligns.
olivia: Good points. Planning CTA after hero. Proposed UTM example: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_apr` — will replace with final when jamal provides.
alex: Product nit: avoid phrase "linear scaling across GPUs" — reality is "near-linear under typical batch sizes". Suggest swapping that sentence to be precise.
maria: :thumbsup: Agree with Alex. Also add a 3-bullet TL;DR list under the hero for scannability.
olivia: Updated draft (v2) here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xDRAFT/edit — changed benchmark phrasing, added bullets, left CTA placeholder REGISTER_LINK.
content-bot: Reminder — run SEO checklist before publish: meta title, OG image, H1, 160-char meta desc. See /seo-checklist for details.
sophie: Legal quick pass: remove the customer name used in the testimonial (we don't have explicit consent). Also add "aggregated" to the benchmark phrasing to avoid implying individual user data. Otherwise looks fine.
jamal: I'll get the webinar URL + final UTM by EOD. For inbound routing, can we map registrants to the list `launch-apr-registrants` in HubSpot? That makes downstream nurture simpler.
olivia: Yes — @jamal pls add final link and UTM, I'll swap REGISTER_LINK -> final URL and update the PR. Maria — is Wed 10am PT still the plan for publish?
maria: Yes, 10am PT works. I'll schedule social and the HubSpot campaign to start 1 hour after publish. Approve for publish once legal tweak + final UTM/link are in.
qa-bot: Smoke-test checklist created: https://app.asana.com/0/12345/67890 — tasks assigned to olivia and jamal for staging preview & link check.
olivia: Thanks — will update by 5pm PST and ping here when final. :rocket:
olivia (18:12): Final update: doc v3 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xDRAFT/edit?usp=sharing — benchmark line now: "aggregated median token latency"; replaced REGISTER_LINK with final URL and UTM. Final UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_apr_v1` Final registration URL: https://register.example.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_apr_v1. Pushed preview to staging.
sophie: Legal signoff: cleared all flagged items, testimonial redacted.
jamal: Confirmed registration URL and mapped inbound to `launch-apr-registrants` list. Final paid campaign UTM will be the same campaign value (launch_apr_v1) with `utm_medium=paid`.
maria: Approved. I'll trigger the publish flow Wed 4/7 10:00 PT and start outreach. Thanks everyone.
olivia: Great — publishing path set. Will post the live URL here once up. :white_check_mark:
